title: Blooming Beauty: The Hottest Bridal Makeup Trends for Spring 2026
excerpt: Discover the most stunning spring bridal makeup trends of 2026 and learn how to effortlessly wear them on your wedding day.
content: Spring 2026 is embracing a breathtaking fusion of soft, dewy skin and bold, expressive accents — think luminous glass-skin bases paired with unexpected pops of coral and peach on the eyes and cheeks, a nod to the season's blooming florals. Blush tones are having a major moment, with brides opting for monochromatic looks that layer matching hues across the lids, lips, and cheekbones for a cohesive, romantic finish that photographs beautifully in natural light. At Velora Bella, our Fort Lauderdale artists are also seeing a rise in feathered, brushed-up brows and glossy, barely-there lips that give brides a fresh, modern elegance — effortlessly luxurious looks that feel as timeless as the vows themselves.

title: Gilded Glamour: Luxury Bridal Beauty Trends Redefining the Modern Bride
excerpt: Discover the opulent beauty trends elevating bridal looks in 2026, from luminous skin to editorial eye artistry.
content: Today's luxury brides are embracing bold yet refined beauty statements, including glass-skin finishes, 24-karat gold leaf accents, and custom-blended lip colors crafted exclusively for their wedding day. Soft architectural liner and feathered brows are replacing traditional techniques, bringing a couture editorial feel to bridal aesthetics. At Velora Bella, we artfully blend these trends with each bride's unique features to create a timeless, high-fashion look.
